fitness_functions.name: bound-stays-behavioral
fitness_functions.description: TypeOK domains stay sized to the behavior's distinctions (mode 0..4, orders/shipped 0..3, retries 0..2, auditLog 0..12; bound 6,240 as of 2026-07-21). A counter widened back to production width was the original accidental-complexity finding here.

fitness_functions.name: hub-density-stays-deliberate
fitness_functions.description: Exactly the hub trio (mode, auditLog, dirty) may be dense rows -- that coupling is the app's design. A fourth dense row, invariant-invisible state, or an unjustified variable means new bookkeeping is smearing across the hub.
